question: What does nursing informatics primarily combine with nursing science?
explanation: Nursing informatics merges nursing principles with computer and information sciences to manage healthcare data effectively. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h1)

question: Why is it helpful for nurses to understand different types of computers?

options.A: To appreciate what clinical devices can do in patient care
options.C: To purchase hardware for the ward
options.D: To write software for electronic records

explanation: Knowing computer types helps you understand how different clinical devices can assist you in delivering great patient care! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h1)

question: Which type of computer processes continuous physical signals like an ECG reading?
explanation: Analog computers handle continuous physical measurements directly without converting them to numbers first—just like tracking heartbeat waves on a monitor. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h2)

question: What data format do standard electronic health record systems use to store information?
explanation: Digital computers rely on discrete binary data (zeros and ones) to securely store and process patient health records. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h2)

question: What is the main way computers are grouped into different physical categories?
explanation: Computers are categorized mainly by their physical size, storage capacity, and how fast they can process information. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h3)

question: A hospital wanting to manage data for all its departments at the same time needs which kind of system?
explanation: Managing hospital-wide data requires large systems with high processing power capable of handling multiple users at once. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h3)

question: What is another common name for a microcomputer?
explanation: Microcomputers are widely known as personal computers, which includes the desktops, laptops, and tablets you use every day. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h4)

question: When a nurse charts patient vital signs directly at the bedside using a tablet, which device type is being used?
explanation: Tablets and handheld devices used for quick bedside charting fall right under the category of microcomputers. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h4)

question: What is the main job of a mainframe computer in a large hospital?

options.C: Serving as the central data backbone

explanation: Mainframes act like the powerful central heart of the hospital, securely managing huge volumes of data and connecting all departments. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h5)

question: Which feature makes mainframe computers so important for hospital administrative and clinical records?
explanation: Mainframes provide the heavy-duty security and processing power needed to handle thousands of hospital transactions safely at the same time. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h5)

question: Where are supercomputers typically used in the medical field?
explanation: Supercomputers handle massive scientific tasks like genomic mapping and drug research rather than everyday ward duties. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h6)

question: What is the main difference between a supercomputer and a standard hospital mainframe?

options.B: Their unmatched calculation speed and power
options.C: Their reliance on analog data inputs
options.D: Their ability to chart vital signs

explanation: Supercomputers are built with extreme processing speeds designed for heavy-duty scientific calculations that ordinary computers can't touch. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h6)

question: What is a very important factor to consider when choosing computers for Nigerian clinical settings?

options.A: Local infrastructural constraints like power supply
options.B: The acoustic design of the internal fan
options.C: The brand color of the computer casing
options.D: The weight of the computer keyboard

explanation: Things like stable electricity and network connectivity play a huge role in choosing equipment that will actually work reliably in our hospitals. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h7)

question: How does choosing the right computer system improve patient care in the hospital?

options.A: It eliminates the need for clinical staff
options.B: It increases paperwork burden for nurses
options.C: It improves workflow and reduces medical errors

explanation: Getting the right technology in place helps streamline your nursing tasks and cuts down on mistakes that can happen with manual paperwork. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T6#GNS113_U1_T6_h7)
